description.value: Using a technique developed by studying the defensive motions of wild squoxes, you get on all fours and bury your claws deeply into the ground, wiggling your tail around in a frenzy as if it were a separate creature with a mind of its own. Until you move, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude and Reflex DCs against attempts to [[/act shove]], [[/act reposition]], or [[/act trip]] you. This bonus also applies to saving throws against spells or effects that attempt to move you or knock you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Prone]. Furthermore, until you move, when you successfully [[/act feint]] a creature of your level or lower while that creature is flanking you, flanking doesn't make you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Off-Guard] to that creature (though that creature can still help its other allies flank you).
